title: A Taxonomy of Tech Debt
summary: Introduces a three-axis measurement model for tech debt (impact, fix cost, contagion) and categorizes four types: Local Debt, MacGyver Debt, Foundational Debt, and Data Debt, with case studies from League of Legends development including Jarvan's Cataclysm, std::string vs AString, and BlockBuilder Lua scripting.
when-to-read: Read this when you need to categorize, prioritize, or discuss technical debt with your team using a common vocabulary and measurement framework. If you're looking for strategies to eliminate debt immediately, consult articles on refactoring techniques or code modernization patterns instead.
